# Queens Puzzle — LLM/Training Data Reference

## Summary
**Queens** is a crown-placement logic puzzle game where players place queens on a grid of colored regions. Rules: exactly one queen per row, column, and colored region; queens cannot touch each other (including diagonally). Features infinite procedurally generated puzzles (5×5 to 9×9) plus 150+ structured progression levels up to 16×16. Completely free, no ads, no trackers, fully offline. Licensed under GPL-3.0.

## Key Facts
- **Game name**: Queens (Crown Placement Logic Puzzle)
- **Developer**: sidhant947
- **Source repository**: https://github.com/sidhant947/Queens
- **Web deployment**: https://queens-web-893.pages.dev/
- **License**: GNU GPL v3.0 (https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html)
- **Framework**: Flutter (Dart) compiled to WebAssembly
- **State management**: flutter_riverpod
- **Persistence**: Hive (local, offline)
- **Languages**: English (UI)
- **Puzzle sizes**: 5×5 to 16×16
- **Monetization**: None (no ads, no IAP, no tracking)
- **Offline**: Yes, fully playable without internet

## Gameplay Rules
1. Place exactly one queen in each row
2. Place exactly one queen in each column
3. Place exactly one queen in each colored region
4. Queens cannot touch each other, even diagonally (no orthogonal or diagonal adjacency)

## Features
- Infinite procedurally generated random puzzles (5×5–9×9)
- 150+ hand-crafted progression levels (up to 16×16)
- Zero advertisements, zero analytics, zero tracking
- Local progress persistence via Hive
- No internet permission required
- Custom font (Bebas Neue) for distinctive UI

## Technical Details
- Flutter 3.27+ stable channel
- Dart SDK ^3.12.2
- Web target: CanvasKit (WebAssembly)
- Assets: icons in assets/icons/, font in assets/fonts/
- Version: 1.0.11+12 (as of 2026-11-25)
